spec.description: New example for step 3c/3e of llm-dlc/loops/sound-verdicts.md. Crosscut gains Jitter#fullJitterMillis (full jitter: Random.nextInt below a ceiling shifted with Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros). The proof runs under --engine native --gaps advised --contracts gaps.contracts, contracts an agent wrote for the three JDK calls the tool's own checker does not implement. The one for nextInt(int) omits IllegalArgumentException when bound <= 0, so the JVM test refutes it at bound=0 and the run stops before solving with the gap open, the JVM's counterexamples in the advice; the other two contracts are accepted (numberOfLeadingZeros proved against the JDK's bytecode, Random(long) tested).
spec.expected: verdict unverifiable (gaps-need-contracts), the advice naming jdk-primitive-method:java.util.Random.nextInt(I)I@jdk-25.0.4.1 with its refused contract and the counterexample bound=0, expected verdict met
